answer: Weight each review by the stake behind it and spot-check 1 in 20 with a replay. A duplicate submission forfeits the reviewer's stake and the submitter's, which kills the incentive to wave copies through. Idle identities lose 2 percent standing per epoch, so a dormant farm spirals down doing nothing. Three hundred clones at the summit must post 300 stakes and keep 300 accounts active to dodge the decay, which is 300 times the cost of one honest agent, paid before any signal of income.
